about: Per-game overlay on GameDatabase: regions (game region -> anchor region in RegionCatalog), the hosts of each part of the game's traffic for the doctor, and notes. Hosts are checked live on every line and nothing is steered unless a fix is proven there, so a wrong or dead host costs a line of 'unclear', never a broken game. Lists marked verified=false still need a lab session with the game installed.

games.noteFa: سرور خاورمیانهٔ کالاف (بحرین) از اسفند ۱۴۰۴ آسیب دیده؛ اگر بازی اجازه می‌دهد، منطقه‌ای را بزن که بوستر پیشنهاد می‌کند.
games.noteEn: Call of Duty's Middle East server (Bahrain) has been damaged since March 2026; if the game lets you, pick the region the booster suggests.

games.noteFa: سرورهای خاورمیانهٔ پابجی از اسفند ۱۴۰۴ خاموش‌اند و بازیکن‌های منطقه به اروپا منتقل شده‌اند.
games.noteEn: PUBG Mobile's Middle East servers have been offline since March 2026; the region's players were moved to Europe.

games.name: EA SPORTS FC Mobile
games.noteFa: EA به‌خاطر تحریم، ورود از ایران را می‌بندد؛ بوستر بخش ورود را با DNS ضدتحریمی باز می‌کند که روی اینترنت خودت امتحان شده.
games.noteEn: EA blocks sign-in from Iran because of sanctions; the booster opens the sign-in part with an anti-sanction DNS it has tried on your own line.
